chunks: And who preferred the life of the world,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to prefer the worldly life over the hereafter in Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase characterizes the *ahl al-dunya* who, despite possessing faith, allowed worldly desires to overshadow their ultimate accountability, a theme central to the concept of *Zuhd* (asceticism). It underscores the ethical imperative to align one's actions with eternal values rather than transient pleasures, serving as a warning against spiritual complacency during divine judgment.
